rules.title: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization Ordinance
rules.requirement: Annual residential rent increases are capped at the lower of 3% per year or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period, with no rent increase allowed if the CPI change is negative.

coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental property constructed on or before February 1, 1995.

rules.exemptions: Residential buildings constructed after February 1, 1995, or mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990.
rules.quoted_span: Increase in residential rents are limited to the lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period. If the CPI is negative, no rent increase is permitted.

rules.title: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.requirement: Landlords cannot terminate a tenancy after 30 days without specified at-fault or no-fault just cause, and must provide 3 months of relocation assistance or a 3-month rent waiver for no-fault evictions.

coverage.summary: Applies after 30 days of tenancy, excluding housing built in the last 15 years, deed-restricted affordable housing, dormitories, and certain other facilities.
coverage.unresolvable: Tenancy duration of at least 30 days

rules.exemptions: Housing produced in the last 15 years; deed-restricted affordable housing; hotel and transient occupancy; hospital and care facilities; dormitories; and other shared living quarters.
rules.quoted_span: After 30 days, an owner shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in a written notice.
